THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Order under Section 4(1)
WHEREAS AN Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner of Labour which accompaniesthis order exists between,
Mr. N.K. Upali Rupasinghe, No. 24/2, Liyanage Mawatha, Nawala Road, Rajagiriya.
and
Sri Lankan Airlines Limited, Bandaranaike International Airport, Katunayake.

NOW THEREFORE I, Ravindra Samaraweera, Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations do by virtue of the powers vested in me bySection 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition), as amended byAct, Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes - Special Provisions) Act, No. 37 of 1968 hereby appointMr. S.G.Sooriyaarachchi, No. 22/1, Siri Pemarathana Mawatha, Menikdiwela to be the arbitrator and refer the aforesaid dispute to him forsettlement by arbitration.
RAVINDRA SAMARAWEERAMinister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.
28th February, 2019.
Colombo.

THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Mr. N. K. Upali Rupasinghe, No. 24/2, Liyanage Mawatha, Nawala Road, Rajagiriya.and
Sri Lankan Airlines Limited, Bandaranaike International Airport, Katunayake.
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is–
Whether Mr. N. K. Upali Rupasinghe working at Sri Lankan Airlines Limited had been caused injustice by,

1.Not being promoted up to now, after joining as a Grade E-V Executive Engineer from 20.02.1998 with a long foreign experienceand been promoted as a Grade 9 Manager from 01.04.2001,2.Suspension of the previdge given when he joined employment to reimburse a sum equal to the value of 30 gallons of petrol witheffect from 01.10.1999 without prior notice,3.Being given only the first 20% salary increase out of the 40% salary increase allowed by Circular dated 23.11.1999 which hadbeen given to all other employees in two 20% installmentsand4.Deprival of the on-call allowance of Rs.5000/- which was given from his appointment date with effect from 01.01.2011, Andif such injustice had been caused to what relief he is entitled.
A. WIMALAWEERA,Commissioner of Labour.
Dated at the Office of the Commissioner of Labour,Colombo this 26th day of January 2019.
